title: 词汇理解失败导致临床推理失误：评估面向Alpha世代治疗机器人的安全风险
summary: 该研究针对面向Gen Alpha的心理健康聊天机器人，提出两个基准测试，发现模型存在10-14个百分点的词汇理解-临床风险校准差距，识别出六种失败模式，并建议采用人类参与架构和监管框架。
summary_en: This study evaluates therapy bots for Gen Alpha, proposing two benchmarks and finding a 10-14 percentage point gap between vocabulary comprehension and clinical risk calibration, identifying six failure patterns, and recommending human-in-the-loop architectures and regulatory frameworks.
